title_en: Dexter: Resurrection Season 2 First Look Teases Return of Quinn, New Kills, Romance, and More
summary_en: The first official look at Dexter: Resurrection Season 2 has been released, and it seems like Dex will be reckoning with his past once again.
body_en:
The first official look at Dexter: Resurrection Season 2 has been released, and it seems like Dex will be reckoning with his past once again.
Paramount has released the first images from Dexter: Resurrection Season 2, which tease a lot of new stressful situations for Dex. The biggest tease is an image that reveals that Joey Quinn, Dexter's former colleague, is returning. Actor Desmond Harrington reprised his role as Quinn in the last season for a brief cameo, but also planted small seeds for a larger role in Season 2. Quinn was aware that Angel Batista was digging into something big, but was never clued in to the specifics. Now that Batista is dead, it seems likely that Quinn will turn up in New York looking for answers.
While some fans have long theorized that Quinn knows Dexter is a killer and has turned a blind eye to it for years, one has to imagine that he wouldn't take kindly to finding out Dexter is at least partially responsible for the deaths of Batista and Deb, for whom Quinn was harboring romantic feelings. How will the show resolve all of this, though? It would be, admittely, be kind of lame if it were a rehash of what happened with Batista last season. So long as the writers are willing to take big swings and avoid playing it safe, this has serious potential to be a really thrilling conflict for Dexter.
The second big takeaway from these images is that Uma Thurman's character, Charley, will return, and may even have some kind of romantic encounter with Dexter. The two can be seen gently holding hands while sipping wine at a nice dinner. The character had largely discarded her loyalties to Leon Prater last season, but didn't seem to have much affection for Dexter himself. Perhaps there's more than meets the eye, but it is interesting to see a former antagonist return like this. Charley won't be the only antagonist returning this season either, but .
Finally, in direct contrast to Dexter's murderous lifestyle, Harrison has joined the New York police department. He appears to be following in his family's footsteps, though more explicitly his aunt Deb, who was a cop while Dexter was part of the forensics team. This shouldn't come as a massive surprise, as Harrison expressed interest in this career path and was eyeing school for it. However, it will be interesting to see what kind of conflicts this could create between the serial killer father and his law abiding son... or maybe, they'll become allies.
All in all, it looks like fans are in for another suspenseful, stressful, and compelling season of Dexter. We have yet to get official first looks at the villains, which will be played by Brian Cox , Dan Stevens, Gabriel Luna, and others , but we may see more when the first trailer is released in the coming months.
Dexter: Resurrection Season 2 will release on Paramount+ this fall.
Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.
